s: Hadlaqat hannerot beyom hakkippurim ubo y' seipim: yom hakkippurim tzarik lekabbedo benerot kemo bishar yamim tobim kemo sheyyitbaer, ella sheyyesh meqomot shennohagin issur behadlaqat ner belel yom hakkippurim bebayit sheish veishto darim bo, gezera shemma yitavveh leishto kesheyyirenna leor hanner veyabo lide tashmish, abal yesh meqomot shemmadliqin babbayit, shekkevan sheasur leshammesh leor hanner — bevadday lo yabo lide tashmish. Veotan meqomot shemmadliqin tzerikin lebarek "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu lehadliq ner shel yom hakkippurim", shehare yom hakkippurim mitzva lehadliq bo nerot kemo beshabbatot veyamim tobim:

Im yesh lo ner daluq babbayit — tzarik lehadliq ner bacheder shellan bo im ishto, ben bemaqom shennohagin lehadliq ben bemaqom sheen nohagin lehadliq, shekkevan sheroeh et ishto leor hanner shebbabbayit im ken yesh lachosh shemma yabo lide tashmish bacheder sheen sham ner doleq:

Apillu bimqomot sheen madliqin babbayit, mikkol maqom madliqin bebatte kenesiyyot ubebatte midrashot ubimboot haapelot veal gabbe hacholim. Veken im chal yom hakkippurim beshabbat — chayyabin hakkol lehadliq ap bebeto, umebarekin "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu lehadliq ner shel shabbat veshel yom hakkippurim":

Nohagin bekol maqom lehatztzia begadim naim bebet hakkeneset, vegam babbattim lehatztzia mappa yapa al hashshulchan kemo beshabbat veyom tob. Veken nohagim leharbot benerot bebet hakkeneset, shenneemar "al ken baurim kabbedu Hashem", umetargeminan "bepannasayya yaqqeru Hashem. Vetob laasot petilot abot bebet hakkeneset, leharbot oran. Venahagu shekkol ish gadol veqatan osin bishbilo ner lebet hakkeneset. Veakshav nohagin sheen osin ner ella lenasuy bilbad:
Gam nahagu laasot ner neshama leabiv uleimmo shemmetu:

Veim kabu nerot ellu beyom hakkippurim — en lomar lenokri sheyyachazor lehadliqan. Vaapillu lerammez lo asur. Velo od ella sheim ba lehadliq meatzmo — tzarik limchot beyado kemo shennitbaer besiman ra"v. Veken en lomar lenokri leqabbel shaava hannotep min hannerot, mippene shehayyisrael asur lo letaltel hashshaava mippene shehi muqtzeh kemo shennitbaer besiman rs"h, vekol sheen hetter lehayyisrael letaltelo — asur lomar lenokri letaltelo kemo shennitbaer besiman ra"v, ayyen sham:

Venahagu liqqach nokri lishmor hannerot shello yabo chas veshalom lide deleqa, umikkoach zeh nahagu hehamon lomar lo lekabbot ulehadliq, veen lazeh hetter kelal, veyesh limchot beyadam, ubiprat beyom haddin:

Mi shekkaba nero beyom hakkippurim — siman ra lo. Vetaqqanato, sheyyachazor veyadliqennu bemotzae yom hakkippurim, velo yekabbennu od ella yannichennu lidloq ad gemira, vegam yeqabbel alayv shekkol yamayv lo yekabbeh nero bemotzae yom hakkippurim lo hu velo acher ella yannichennu lidloq ad gemira. ("Liqdosh Hashem mekubbad" — zeh yom hakkippurim sheen bo akila ushetiyya, omra tora kabbeduhu biksut neqiyya ubenerot, lepikak nohagin lehatztzia begadim naim bebet hakkeneset):

Yesh nohagin lilbosh begadim lebanim neqiyyim beyom hakkippurim, kede lihyot dugmat malake hashsharet. Veken nohagin bimdinot ellu lilbosh haqqitel, shehu beged laban venaqi. Veyesh od taam bilbishat haqqitel, mippene shehu beged metim veal yede zeh nikna leb adam laasot teshuba shelema, ulepikak gam mi shehu abel muttar lilbosh haqqitel. Veken hannashim yekolot lilbosh haqqitel kede lehaknia libban, abal shear begadim lebanim en lahen lilbosh kede lihyot dugmat malake hashsharet, sheen yekolot lihyot kemalakim, shenneemar "ir gibborim ala chakam vego'", "gebarim" ketib:
Hallobesh saq mechamat teshuba — tzarik leposhto beyom hakkippurim, mippene shehu yom tob vetzarik lekabbedo biksut neqiyya kemo shennitbaer:
